faq.a1: Noma ngabe yikuphi ikhopharethi lesaziwa ngaphansi kwe-Cooperative Societies Act ingabhaliswa sisikhulu sefederesheni lesigunyaziwe noma sisikhulu selitiko.
faq.a2: Yebo — basebentisi basemakhaya bangathwebula data nge-Progressive Web App futsi bahlanganise ngekuzenzekela uma kuxhuma kubuyile.
faq.a3: CoopData ifika ne-English, SiSwati nePortuguese. Tilwimi letinye tingezelelwa ngesicelo.
faq.a4: Yonke data iyencitshiwe ngesikhatsi sekuhamba nasekugcineni, nekufinyelela ngekuya ngerole, kucinisekisa ngetindlela letiningi nekuhlola kugcwele.

roa.above: Inzuzo yemphahla engaphezu kwesilinganiso — ukusetjentiswa kahle kwezinsiza.
roa.below: Buyekeza izindleko zokusebenza noma ukubeka intengo yemaloli ukuze uthuthukise imbuyiselo yemphahla.

roe.below: Imbuyiselo yemali yemalunga ingaphansi kwabanye besekta. Buyekeza ukubeka intengo nekusebenta kahle kwezindleko.

operating_expense_ratio.above: Izindleko zokusebenza ziphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nempahla — isiyalo esihle sezindleko.
operating_expense_ratio.below: Izindleko zokusebenza ziphakeme uma kuqhathaniswa nempahla. Thola amathuba okusebenta kahle.

operational_self_sufficiency.above: Kuzimela ngetimali — imali engenayo ihlangabezana nazo zonke izindleko zokusebenza.
operational_self_sufficiency.below: Izindleko zokusebenza zidlula imali engenayo. Buyekeza izakhiwo zezindleko ngokushesha.

loan_loss_coverage.above: Izilungiselelo zekulahlekelwa kwemaloli zifinyelela kahle emaloli asengozini.
loan_loss_coverage.below: Izilungiselelo zingase zinganele uma kuqhathaniswa nemaloli asemuva. Cabanga ukwandisa izivikelo.

default.below: Ukusebenta kwakho kungaphansi kwesilinganiso sesekta. Buyekeza izinqubo ezifanele.

analytics.portfolioOverviewTooltip: Bukhulu bekhopharethi lonkhe inyanga nenyanga. Ikhombisa kutsi ibhalensi shithi ikhula nome incipha njani. Imphahla yonkhe seyihlanganisa emaloli nemphahla lenyakazayo leboniswe kuletinye emashadi, ngako atengetwa kuwo. Ifomula: imphahla yonkhe (1999).

Emakholomu ngemanani lahlukene futsi akahlosile kufaka kanye kuba imphahla yonkhe. Ifomula yemgca: imphahla lenyakazayo yengetwe emaloli agcwele kususwe imali yekonga yemalunga (1100 kwengeta 1200 kususa 2100).

Kutsatfwe etitatimendeni letiphasisiwe ngenyanga yekugcina lebikiwe. Ifomula: imali yemalunga yonkhe ihlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti (3999 phezu kwa-1999).

tip.totalIncome: Yonkhe imali letfolwa emakhopharethi ngesikhatsi, ikakhulu inzalo yemaloli netimali letinye. Ngumgca wekucala wekunenzuzo. Kutsatfwe etitatimendeni tetimali letiphasisiwe futsi kuhlangantiswa etinyangeni letibikiwe, nge-ZAR. Ifomula: imali yengenako yonkhe (4999) ihlangantiswa etinyangeni letibikiwe.
tip.totalExpenditure: Yonkhe imali lesetjentiswe kufaka emakhopharethi asebenta ngesikhatsi, kufaka inzalo lekhokhiwe, basebenti nekuphatsa. Lokuphansi kungcono ngemali lefanako yengenako. Kutsatfwe etitatimendeni tetimali letiphasisiwe futsi kuhlangantiswa etinyangeni letibikiwe, nge-ZAR. Ifomula: tindleko tonkhe (5999) tihlangantiswe etinyangeni letibikiwe.
tip.netIncome: Loko lokusala ngemuva kwetindleko tonkhe. Linani lelihle yinzuzo, lelibi kulahlekelwa. Kutsatfwe etitatimendeni tetimali letiphasisiwe etinyangeni letibikiwe, nge-ZAR. Ifomula: inzuzo lenhle (6999) njengobe ibikiwe, nome kungenjalo imali yengenako yonkhe ikhishwe tindleko tonkhe.
tip.roa: Yinzuzo lenganani letfolwa ngakunye kwemphahla. Lokuphakeme kusho kutsi imphahla isetjentiswa ngendlela lenenzuzo lenyenti. Kutsatfwe etitatimendeni letiphasisiwe, ngesikhatsi lesibikiwe futsi akunyakaziswa, ngako ikota ifundzeka iphansi kunemnyaka. Ifomula: imali yengenako net ihlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.

Kutsatfwe etitatimendeni tetimali letiphasisiwe nge-ZAR, ngesilinganiso lesicinile sembiko ngamunye. Kuvela kuphela emakhopharethi lanenani ngaleyonyanga. Ema-akhawunti ebhalensi shithi akhombisa ibhalensi ekupheleni kwaleyonyanga; inyanga yekugcina lebikiwe isebentisa inyanga yekugcina yakhopharethi ngayinye.
analytics.pcGridInfo: Luhlu lwemaloli lwekhopharethi ngayinye luhlukaniswe ngesimo sekukhokha: lasebentako, lasemuva, langasasebenti, bese kuba tilungiselelo nephothifoliyo net. Ikhombisa kutsi ingoti yesikweletu ikuphi. Kutsatfwe etitatimendeni tetimali letiphasisiwe ngenyanga lekhetsiwe, nge-ZAR. Tindzimi ngenjongo yekuboleka nome ngemalanga langakabikwa atikho kubhalensi shithi lejwayelekile futsi tibhalwa i-n/r, akubikiwe. Ifomula: iphothifoliyo net ngemaloli agcwele akhishwe tilungiselelo.
analytics.incomeGridInfo: Sitatimende semali yengenako yekhopharethi ngayinye kuhlangana: lokutfoliwe, lokusetjentisiwe kanye nenzuzo. Kutsatfwe etitatimendeni tetimali letiphasisiwe nge-ZAR, kuhlangantiswa kusukela ngaJanuwari kuya enyangeni lekhetsiwe. analytics.indicatorsGridInfo: Tilinganiso letibalulekile tekhopharethi ngayinye: imali, linani lemphahla, emaloli lasemuva, tilungiselelo, umsebenti lomuhle nekunyakaza kwemali. Linganiso ngalinye libalwa kusuka esitatimendeni setimali lesiphasisiwe ngenyanga lekhetsiwe; tilinganiso tenzuzo tisebentisa imali yengenako kusukela ngaJanuwari kuya kuleyonyanga, akunyakaziswa, futsi tikhombisa umgca nangabe sitatimende asinato tinhlobo temali yengenako. TOTAL_MISMATCH.what: Isamba sezinto zomugqa zesigaba esincane asihambisani nenani elibikiwe. Lokhu kuvamise kusho ukuthi ezinye izinto zomugqa zamaphishwa kukhodi ye-akhawunti engalungile, noma ama-akhawunti abalulekile ashoda.
TOTAL_MISMATCH.fix: Hlola into ngayinye yomugqa etafuleni. Bheka imigqa enokuqiniseka 'Okuphansi' — cishe zamaphishwa kukhodi engalungile. Sebenzisa idropdown yekhodi ye-akhawunti ukuze uphinde uzinikeze kahle. Ngemva kokulungisa, chofoza Phindza Cinisekisa.

BALANCE_UNBALANCED.what: Imphahla Yonke ≠ Izikweletu Zonke + Imali Yemalunga Yonke. I-equation eyisisekelo yokubala iphukile.
BALANCE_UNBALANCED.fix: Lokhu kuvamise kusho ukuthi inani elilodwa noma amaningi amaphishwa ngendlela engalungile. Qinisekisa ukuthi ikhodi 1999 iphethe Imphahla Yonke, 2999 iphethe Izikweletu Zonke, kanti 3999 iphethe Imali Yemalunga Yonke. Phindza unikeze noma yiziphi izinto ezingalungile.

MISSING_ACCOUNT.what: Ikhodi ye-akhawunti edingekako ayikho kudata ekhishiwe. I-AI ayikwazanga ukuthola noma ukumaphisha ngekuqiniseka le nsimu kusuka kudokhumenti yakho.
MISSING_ACCOUNT.fix: Skrola esigabeni se-'Izinto Ezingamaphishiwe' phansi kwetafula. Thola into ehambisana nale-akhawunti futsi usebenzise idropdown ye-'Nika ↑' ukuze unikeze ikhodi elungile.

LIQUIDITY_CRISIS.what: Imphahla enyakazayo (imali + ukutshala imali kwesikhatsi esifishane) ihlangabezana nangezinsuku ezingaphansi kwe-50% zezikweletu zesikhatsi esifishane. Lona yinkomba yengozi ebucayi.
LIQUIDITY_CRISIS.fix: Qinisekisa ukuthi amakhodi emphahla enyakazayo (1101, 1102, 1103, 1104) namakhodi emadiphozithi (2101, 2102, 2103) anikezwe kahle. Uma amanani abukeka elungile, lena yingozi yetimali yangempela edinga ukunakwa kwabaphatsi.

LOW_LIQUIDITY.what: Imphahla enyakazayo ingaphansi kwe-10% yemphahla yonke. Kungase kube ukuthi imali/ukutshala imali kubikwe ngaphansi noma ikhopharethi inemithombo emincane kakhulu enyakazayo.
LOW_LIQUIDITY.fix: Hlola ukuthi onke ama-akhawunti emali (1101, 1102, 1103) nokutshala imali kwesikhatsi esifishane (1104) akhonjwe futsi amaphishwa kahle. Bheka noma yiziphi izinto zemali esigabeni sezingamaphishiwe.

CASH_TOO_LOW.what: Imali esesandleni nasebhange ingaphansi kwe-2% yemphahla yonke, okuyinto ephansi kakhulu ngokuyingozi yemisebenzi yansuku zonke.
CASH_TOO_LOW.fix: Qinisekisa ukuthi amakhodi 1101 (Imali Esesandleni), 1102 (Imali Ebhange Yamanje), 1103 (Imali Ebhange Yekonga) amaphishwa kahle namanani alungile.

NPL_HIGH.what: Emaloli angasebenzi adlula i-10% yephothifoliyo yemaloli yonke. Lokhu kungaphezu komkhawulo wesixwayiso.
NPL_HIGH.fix: Qinisekisa ukuthi amakhodi 1201–1205 anikezwe kahle kumabhulakethi ekhwalithi yemaloli alungile. Uma data ilungile, lokhu kubonisa ingozi yesikweletu yangempela edinga isenzo sabaphatsi.

UNDER_PROVISIONING.what: Isilungiselelo esicacile sekulahlekelwa kwemaloli (ikhodi 1252) sihlangabezana nangezinsuku ezingaphansi kwe-50% zemaloli angasebenzi (ikhodi 1205). Lokhu kungase kube ukwephula umthetho.
UNDER_PROVISIONING.fix: Hlola ukuthi 1252 (Isilungiselelo Esicacile Sekulahlekelwa Kwemaloli) simaphishiwe futsi sigcinwe njengenombolo ENGENHLE. Futhi qinisekisa ukuthi 1205 (Emaloli Angasebenzi) ilungile.

LOW_EQUITY.what: Imali yemalunga ingaphansi kwe-10% yemphahla yonke. Ikhopharethi kungase ibe ngephansi kwemali.
LOW_EQUITY.fix: Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izingxenye zemali yemalunga zamaphishiwe: 3101 (Imali Yamasheya Ehlala Njalo), 3102 (Amasheya Angakhishwa), 3201 (Isivikelo Somthetho), 3301 (Inzuzo Enqwabelene), 3302 (Inzuzo Yonyaka Wamanje).

STATUTORY_RESERVE_MISSING.what: Isivikelo somthetho (ikhodi 3201) singu-zero noma asikho. Lokhu kuyadingeka ngokomthetho kwemakhopharethi.
STATUTORY_RESERVE_MISSING.fix: Hlola ukuthi idokhumenti elayishiwe lihlanganisa isivikelo somthetho noma esemthethweni. Uma kunjalo, sithole ezintweni ezingamaphishiwe futsi unikeze ikhodi 3201.

HIGH_LEVERAGE.what: Izinga lesikweletu kuya ku-equity lidlula umkhawulo wenhloso ka-2:1.
HIGH_LEVERAGE.fix: Qinisekisa ukuthi izikweletu zonke (2999) nemali yemalunga yonke (3999) zamaphishiwe kahle. Uma data ilungile, lena yinkinga yetimali yangempela.

LOW_PROFITABILITY.what: Imbuyiselo Yemphahla (ROA) ingaphansi kwe-1%. Ikhopharethi ikhiqiza inzalo encane kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nesisekelo sempahla yayo.
LOW_PROFITABILITY.fix: Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-akhawunti emali engenayo (4101, 4102, 4201) nama-akhawunti ezindleko (5101–5301) wonke amaphishiwe kahle futsi ukuthi inzalo yonyaka wamanje (3302) ikhona.

MISSING_DATA.what: Insimu ebalulekile edingekako yohlatiyo lwetimali ayikho kudata ekhishiwe.
MISSING_DATA.fix: Hlola isigaba sezinto ezingamaphishiwe phansi kwetafula. Insimu kungase ibe ikhishiwe kodwa inganikwanga ikhodi. Sebenzisa idropdown ukuze unikeze ikhodi ye-akhawunti elungile.

DEFAULT.what: Inkinga yekhwalithi yedata noma yempilo yetimali itholakele.
DEFAULT.fix: Buyekeza inani eliphawuliwe, hlola amakhodi ama-akhawunti anikezwe ngendlela engalungile, futsi chofoza Phindza Cinisekisa ngemva kokwenza ukulungiswa.

assetEvolution.title: Kukhula kwemphahla
assetEvolution.subtitle: Imphahla yonkhe ngesikhatsi
assetEvolution.info: Kutsi bukhulu bemakhopharethi lakubukwako buguquka njani kusukela kwesinye sikhatsi sekubika kuya kwesinye. Kukhula kusho kutsi ibhalensi shithi iyanaba. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi ngasinye futsi kuhlangantiswa kuwo onkhe emakhopharethi lakubukwako. Ifomula: imphahla lengesiyo yesikhashana kwengeta imphahla yesikhashana.

savingsTrend.title: Trendi yemali yekonga
savingsTrend.subtitle: Imali yekonga yemalunga ngesikhatsi
savingsTrend.info: Kutsi imali legciniwe emalunga njengemali yekonga iguquka njani ngesikhatsi. Kukhula kwemali yekonga kusho kwakha lokutsenjwa emalungeni nemali lenyenti yekuboleka. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi ngasinye futsi kuhlangantiswa kuwo onkhe emakhopharethi lakubukwako. Ifomula: linani lemali yekonga net labesifazane kwengeta labesilisa.

loanPortfolio.title: Iphothifoliyo yemaloli
loanPortfolio.subtitle: Emaloli lasesele ngesikhatsi
loanPortfolio.info: Kutsi bukhulu lobukweletwa emalunga emalolini buguquka njani ngesikhatsi. Kukhula kusho kuboleka lokunyenti, lokuhle kuphela nangabe kukhokha kusahamba kahle. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi ngasinye futsi kuhlangantiswa kuwo onkhe emakhopharethi lakubukwako. Ifomula: linani lemaloli lasesele labesifazane kwengeta labesilisa.

parTrend.title: Iphothifoliyo lesesengotini
parTrend.subtitle: Trendi yePAR ngesikhatsi
parTrend.info: Incenye yeluhlu lwemaloli lesemuva, ngekwemalanga lamanyenti. Ikhombisa kutsi tinkinga tekukhokha tiyakhula nome tiyancipha; lokuphansi kungcono. Kutsatfwe kumabhakede emalanga asemuva embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi ngasinye, kusebentisa emanani lahlangantisiwe. Ifomula: ibhalensi lesemuva kulinganiso ngalinye ihlukaniswe ngemaloli agcwele, njengeliphesenti.

liquidity.title: Kunyakaza kwemali kuya kumali yekonga yemalunga
liquidity.subtitle: Kunyakaza kwemali okugcinwe macondzana nelinani lelincane lemtsetfo
liquidity.info: Bukhulu lobungakhokhwa ngesikhatsinye kumali yekonga yemalunga kusuka kumali lekhona nasebhange, kufananiswa nelinani lelincane lema-15%. Umgca ukhombisa sikhala: ngetulu kwelutfo sisweleko. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi ngasinye. Ifomula: imphahla lenyakazayo ihlukaniswe ngemali yekonga yemalunga, njengeliphesenti.

financialStructure.title: Sakhiwo setimali lesisebentako
financialStructure.subtitle: Kutsi imphahla ifakelwa imali futsi isetjentiswa njani
financialStructure.info: Kutsi imphahla yekhopharethi isetjentiswa njani futsi ifakelwa imali kuphi. Emakholomu akhombisa imphahla lenenzuzo, imali yekonga yemalunga nemasheya emalunga njengencenye yemphahla yonkhe; umgca kuluhlangotsi lwangesekudla ukhombisa imali leboleketwe. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi ngasinye. Ifomula: intfo ngayinye ihlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.

profitability.title: Kunenzuzo
profitability.subtitle: Imali yengenako net ngesikhatsi
profitability.info: Kutsi emakhopharethi enta inzuzo nome kulahlekelwa ngesikhatsi ngasinye. Emakholomu langetulu kwelutfo yinzuzo. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi ngasinye. Ifomula: imali yengenako net njengobe ibikiwe, nome kungenjalo imali yengenako yonkhe ikhishwe tindleko tonkhe.

institutionalCapital.title: Imali yesikhungo kuya kumphahla
institutionalCapital.subtitle: Imali yesikhungo macondzana nelinani lelincane
institutionalCapital.info: Yincenye lengakanani yemphahla levikelwe titivikelo tekhopharethi, kufananiswa nelinani lelincane lema-8%. Umgca ukhombisa lokwengetiwe nome lokusweleko. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi ngasinye. Ifomula: inzuzo legciniwe kwengeta tivikelo temtsetfo kwengeta timo, kuhlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.

marketShareAssets.title: Sabelo semakethe ngemphahla yonkhe
marketShareAssets.subtitle: Sabelo sekhopharethi ngayinye emphahleni lehlangantisiwe
marketShareAssets.info: Bukhulu lengakanani yemphahla yonkhe lekubukwako lekhopharethi ngayinye inayo. Ikhombisa emakhopharethi lasisindvo lesikhulu kakhulu. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe; emakhopharethi langakabiki imphahla ashiywa etulu. Ifomula: imphahla yonkhe yekhopharethi ihlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe yawo onkhe emakhopharethi laboniswe, njengeliphesenti.

marketShareLoans.title: Sabelo semakethe ngemaloli
marketShareLoans.subtitle: Sabelo sekhopharethi ngayinye eluhlwini lwemaloli lehlangantisiwe
marketShareLoans.info: Bukhulu lengakanani yemaloli onkhe lekubukwako lekhopharethi ngayinye inayo. Ikhombisa emakhopharethi labolekisa kakhulu. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe; emakhopharethi langakabiki emaloli ashiywa etulu. Ifomula: emaloli lasesele yekhopharethi ahlukaniswe ngemaloli lasesele awo onkhe emakhopharethi laboniswe, njengeliphesenti.

demographics.title: Umumo wemalunga
demographics.subtitle: Bulili nelibanga leminyaka lemalunga
demographics.info: Bobani emalunga: emalunga labhalisiwe nalasebentako ngebulili, nemalunga labhalisiwe ngelibanga leminyaka. Ikhombisa kutsi buhlanga bemalunga bulinganile futsi busemusha kangakanani. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe futsi kuhlangantiswa kuwo onkhe emakhopharethi lakubukwako. Emabanga eminyaka ngu-18 kuya ku-25, 26 kuya ku-35, 36 kuya ku-60 nangetulu kwa-60.

governance.title: Besifazane ekuphatseni
governance.subtitle: Incenye yebesifazane kuboholi
governance.info: Bangaki besifazane labahleti ebhodini, ekomitini lekuphatsa nasekomitini lesikweletu. Ikhombisa kutsi besifazane bayabandzakanyeka yini etincumeni. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: besifazane kusikhungo ngasinye bahlukaniswe ngawo onkhe emalunga aso, njengeliphesenti.

ranking.title: Kuhlelwa kwemakhopharethi
ranking.subtitle: Tilinganiso letibalulekile ngekhopharethi
ranking.info: Emanani lakhulu ekhopharethi ngayinye ngesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe, ehlangana. Umgca usho kutsi khopharethi ayibikanga linani. Imibalabala ifananisa i-PAR ngetulu kwemalanga langu-30 nekubeketelela (loluhlata kuya kuma-5%, ophuzi kuya kuma-10, lobovu ngetulu), kanye nekunyakaza kwemali nemali eyisisekelo nemalinani lawo lamancane lemtsetfo ema-15 nema-8%. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe.

help.registered_members: Wonkhe umuntfu lobhalise njengelilunga, besifazane nebesilisa ndzawonye. Ikhombisa bukhulu besisekelo sebulunga. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe futsi kuhlangantiswa kuwo onkhe emakhopharethi lakubukwako. Ifomula: labesifazane labhalisiwe kwengeta labesilisa labhalisiwe.
help.active_members: Emalunga lasebentako njengamanje, lokusho kutsi abandzakanyeka kukhopharethi. Linani lelicishe lifane nemalunga labhalisiwe lisho tisekelo letibandzakanyekile. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: labesifazane lasebentako kwengeta labesilisa lasebentako.
help.inactive_members: Emalunga labhalisiwe langasebenti. Linani lelikhulu lisikisela kutsi emalunga ashiyile futsi kungadzingeka aphindze abandzakanyeke. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: emalunga labhalisiwe akhishwe emalunga lasebentako.
help.active_members_pct: Incenye yemalunga labhalisiwe lasebentako. Lokuphakeme kungcono, ngoba kukhombisa kutsi bulunga bubandzakanyeke kangakanani. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: emalunga lasebentako ahlukaniswe ngemalunga labhalisiwe, njengeliphesenti.
help.women_members_pct: Incenye yemalunga labhalisiwe labesifazane. Ikhombisa kutsi besifazane babandzakanyeke kahle yini ebulungeni. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: labesifazane labhalisiwe bahlukaniswe ngemalunga labhalisiwe, njengeliphesenti.
help.youth_members_pct: Incenye yemalunga labhalisiwe labaleminyaka lengu-18 kuya kwangu-35. Ikhombisa kutsi khopharethi ifinyelela kahle yini bantfu labasha. Kutsatfwe emabangeni eminyaka embikweni wemibuzo, ngako igcwele kuphela njengobe lawo mabanga enjalo. Ifomula: emalunga laleminyaka lengu-18 kuya kwangu-25 kwengeta laleminyaka lengu-26 kuya kwangu-35, kuhlukaniswe ngemalunga labhalisiwe, njengeliphesenti.
help.number_of_groups: Inani lemacembu emalunga (njengemacembu emali yekonga nome esikweletu) lakhopharethi ibika. Ikhombisa kutsi emalunga ahleliwe kanjani. Kufakiwe ngqo embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: inani lemacembu lelibikiwe.
help.total_deposits: Imali legciniwe emalunga njengemali yekonga kukhopharethi. Lena yincenye lenkhulu yetinsita tekuboleka. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: linani lemali yekonga net labesifazane kwengeta linani lemali yekonga net labesilisa.
help.deposit_accounts: Inani lema-akhawunti emali yekonga lagcinwe emalunga. Ikhombisa kutsi imali yekonga isetjentiswa kangakanani. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: ema-akhawunti emali yekonga alabesifazane kwengeta alabesilisa.
help.avg_savings_per_account: Linani lelijwayelekile leligciniwe nge-akhawunti. Ikhombisa kutsi imali yekonga injani, hhayi kuphela emangaki ema-akhawunti akhona. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imali yekonga yemalunga yonkhe ihlukaniswe ngema-akhawunti emali yekonga.
help.gross_loan_portfolio: Bukhulu lobusesele bukweletwa emalunga emalolini, kufaka emaloli lasemuva, ngaphambi kwetilungiselelo. Yiyona mphahla lekhulu leyingenisa imali yekhopharethi. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe; nangabe emanani lasesele awekho kulinganiselwa kubukhulu lobukweletwa emalunga. Ifomula: linani lemaloli lasesele labesifazane kwengeta labesilisa.
help.loans_outstanding_count: Inani lemaloli lesasa akhokhwa. Ikhombisa emangaki emalunga laboleka. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe; nangabe akufakwanga, kusetjentiswa inani lema-akhawunti emaloli lakhishiwe bese linani liba lelilinganiselwa. Ifomula: inani lemaloli lasesele lebikiwe.
help.avg_loan_balance: Ibhalensi lejwayelekile lesesele kuloli ngalunye. Ikhombisa bukhulu bemaloli akhipha khopharethi. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe; kulinganiselwa nangabe inani lemaloli lasesele lona lilinganiselwa. Ifomula: iphothifoliyo yemaloli agcwele ihlukaniswe ngemaloli lasesele.
help.total_disbursed_active: Linani lekucala lelibolekisiwe emalolini lasasebenta. Kufananiswa nebhalensi lesesele, ikhombisa lokunyenti lokuseva sekukhokhiwe. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: linani lonkhe lelibolekisiwe emalolini lasasebenta lelibikiwe.
help.loans_awaiting_approval: Inani lekufakela ema-loan lelilindzele simonyoro. Luhla loludze lungasho kuphasisa lokungephuti. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: inani lemaloli lalindzele kuphasiswa lebikiwe.
help.loans_in_arrears_count: Inani lemaloli lanekukhokha lokungakabi kahle kanye. Ikhombisa emangaki aboleki labancupheka, nome kunganani linani. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: inani lemaloli lasemuva lebikiwe.
help.projected_interest_earnings: Sibalo lesilinganiselwa senzalo iphothifoliyo yemaloli lengayenta. Kulinganiselwa kuphela, ngoba imali lengenwe ngempela incike etindleleni tekukhokha. Yakhiwe kusuka esilinganisweni sesilinganiso senzalo yembiko wemibuzo, sikhatsi lesijwayelekile kanye nendlela yenzalo. Ifomula: emaloli agcwele kuphindze ngesilinganiso senyanga kuphindze ngesikhatsi lesijwayelekile, kwehlisiwe kabili ngesabelo semaloli langakwehla ibhalensi.
help.female_borrowers_pct: Incenye yaboleki labesifazane. Ikhombisa kutsi besifazane bafinyelela ngendlela lelungile yini esikweletu. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe; nangabe inani labesifazane lababoleki alifakwanga, kusetjentiswa ema-akhawunti emaloli lakhishwe kubesifazane bese linani liba lelilinganiselwa. Ifomula: aboleki labesifazane bahlukaniswe ngemaloli lasesele, njengeliphesenti.
help.total_overdrafts: Linani lonkhe lema-overdraft lanikiwe emalunga. Ema-overdraft ngawesikhashana futsi angaba nengoti nangabe angasuswa. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: linani lonkhe lema-overdraft lelibikiwe.
help.par_gt_7_pct: Incenye yeluhlu lwemaloli lesemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-7. Kuxwayiso lwekucala lwetinkinga tekukhokha. Kudzinga emabhakede emalanga asemuva engcenyeni yeLinga Lemaloli, kungenjalo akubikiwe. Ifomula: ibhalensi lesemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-7 ihlukaniswe ngemaloli agcwele, njengeliphesenti.
help.par_gt_30_pct: Iphothifoliyo lesesengotini ngetulu kwemalanga langu-30: incenye yeluhlu lwemaloli lesemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-30. Linani lelisetulu lisho emaloli lamanyenti langeke abuyiswe, ngako lokuphansi kungcono. Kusetjentiswa emabhakede emalanga asemuva; nangabe atsite, kusetjentiswa inhlobo yekungakhokhi emalangeni langu-31 kuya kwangu-365 bese linani liba lelilinganiselwa. Ifomula: ibhalensi lesemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-30 ihlukaniswe ngemaloli agcwele, njengeliphesenti.
help.par_gt_90_pct: Incenye yeluhlu lwemaloli lesemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-90. Lamaloli akavamile kubuyiswa, ngako lokuphansi kungcono. Kudzinga emabhakede emalanga asemuva engcenyeni yeLinga Lemaloli. Ifomula: ibhalensi lesemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-90 ihlukaniswe ngemaloli agcwele, njengeliphesenti.
help.par_30_90_pct: Incenye yeluhlu lwemaloli lesemuva emalangeni langu-31 kuya kwangu-90. Ikhombisa emaloli lasemuva kakhulu kodvwa angakekafiki ecenjini lelibi kunato tonkhe. Kudzinga emabhakede emalanga asemuva engcenyeni yeLinga Lemaloli. Ifomula: ibhalensi lesemuva emalangeni langu-31 kuya kwangu-90 ihlukaniswe ngemaloli agcwele, njengeliphesenti.
help.par_180_360_pct: Incenye yeluhlu lwemaloli lesemuva emalangeni langu-181 kuya kwangu-360. Lamaloli asamdzala futsi acishe adzinga kususwa. Kudzinga emabhakede emalanga asemuva engcenyeni yeLinga Lemaloli. Ifomula: ibhalensi lesemuva emalangeni langu-181 kuya kwangu-360 ihlukaniswe ngemaloli agcwele, njengeliphesenti.
help.portfolio_at_risk_pct: Incenye yeluhlu lwemaloli lesemuva ngobe kungemalanga lamanyenti. Sisikali lesibanti kakhulu setinkinga tekukhokha, ngako lokuphansi kungcono. Kulinganiselwa nangabe kutincika etinhlotini tekungakhokhi esikhundleni semabhakede emalanga asemuva. Ifomula: ibhalensi yonkhe lesemuva ihlukaniswe ngemaloli agcwele, njengeliphesenti.
help.value_at_risk: Linani lemali lawo onkhe emaloli lasemuva ngobe kungemalanga lamanyenti. Ikhombisa kutsi yincenye lengakanani yeluhlu lwemaloli lesesengotini. Kulinganiselwa nangabe kutincika etinhlotini tekungakhokhi. Ifomula: ibhalensi yawo onkhe emaloli lasemuva.
help.var_gt_7: Linani lemali lemaloli lasemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-7. Kudzinga emabhakede emalanga asemuva engcenyeni yeLinga Lemaloli. Ifomula: ibhalensi lesemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-7.
help.var_gt_30: Linani lemali lemaloli lasemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-30. Lilinani lelisemuva kwesibalo seliphothifoliyo lesesengotini ngetulu kwemalanga langu-30. Kulinganiselwa nangabe kusetjentiswa kuphela inhlobo yekungakhokhi yemalanga langu-31 kuya kwangu-365. Ifomula: ibhalensi lesemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-30.
help.var_gt_90: Linani lemali lemaloli lasemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-90, lawo langeke abuyiswe. Kudzinga emabhakede emalanga asemuva engcenyeni yeLinga Lemaloli. Ifomula: ibhalensi lesemuva ngetulu kwemalanga langu-90.
help.interest_in_suspense: Inzalo lekhokhiswe emalolini kodvwa lengabalwa njengemali yengenako ngoba lobolekile akakhokhi. Linani lelikhulu likhombisa emaloli lasebuthaka. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: inzalo lengakabikwa lebikiwe.
help.interest_payable: Inzalo lekweletwa khopharethi kodvwa lengakakhokhwa, sibonelo kumali yekonga yemalunga nome ekubolekweni. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: inzalo lekufanele ikhokhwe lebikiwe.
help.written_off_loans: Linani lemaloli khopharethi leyekele kuwabuta yawasusa etincwadzini tayo. Ikhombisa kulahlekelwa kwesikweletu kwasesikhatsini lesendlulile. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: emaloli lesuliwe lebikiwe.
help.liquid_assets: Imali lekhona nasebhange lengasetjentiswa ngekushesha kukhokha emalunga. Ikhombisa emandla ekhopharethi ekufinyelela kukhishwa. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imali lekhona kwengeta lesebhange kwengeta imali kutjalo lasebhange.
help.liquidity_ratio_pct: Bukhulu lobungakhokhwa ngesikhatsinye kumali yekonga yemalunga kusuka kumali lekhona nasebhange. Linani lelincane lemtsetfo ngu-15%, ngako lokuphakeme kuphephile. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imphahla lenyakazayo ihlukaniswe ngemali yekonga yemalunga, njengeliphesenti.
help.liquidity_minimum_pct: Linani lelincane lekunyakaza kwemali lekhopharethi lekufanele iligcine, lelibekwe ngumtsetfo ku-15% yemali yekonga yemalunga. Lilinani lelicinile lekufananiswa, hhayi lelibikwe khopharethi. Ifomula: linani lelincane lemtsetfo lemphahla lenyakazayo kuya kumali yekonga yemalunga.
help.liquidity_gap_pct: Yincenye lengakanani khopharethi ikudze kulinani lelincane lekunyakaza kwemali lema-15%. Linani lelihle sisweleko lesidzinga simonyoro; lutfo nome lelibi lisho kutsi linani lelincane lifinyelelwe. Ifomula: linani lelincane lekunyakaza kwemali kukhishwa izinga lekunyakaza kwemali, ngemaphesenti.
help.total_assets: Konkhe lokutfolwa khopharethi. Ikhombisa bukhulu bekhopharethi lonkhe. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imphahla lengesiyo yesikhashana kwengeta imphahla yesikhashana yonkhe.
help.earning_asset_ratio: Incenye yemphahla lenenzuzo, ikakhulu emaloli neto. Lokuphakeme kusho kutsi lokunyenti kwemali yekhopharethi kuyasebenta. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: emaloli kwengeta ekutjaleni imali, kuhlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.
help.member_savings_ratio: Incenye yemphahla leboleketwe imali yekonga yemalunga. Linani lelisetulu lisho kutsi khopharethi itincika kakhulu emalini yemalunga bayo. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imali yekonga yemalunga ihlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.
help.member_share_ratio: Incenye yemphahla leboleketwe emasheya lakatsengwe emalunga. Ikhombisa kutsi emalunga anemphahla lengakanani ngco. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imali yemasheya emalunga ihlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.
help.borrowed_funds_ratio: Incenye yemphahla leboleketwe imali kusuka ngaphandle. Linani lelisetulu lisho kutsincika lokunyenti kubabolekisi nengoti lenyenti. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imali leboleketwe ihlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.
help.loans_to_savings_ratio: Bukhulu lobubolekiwe ngakunye kwelibolekiwe. Cishe ema-100% nome ngetulu kusho kutsi imali yekonga seyibolekiwe yonkhe, kusale imali lencane yekukhipha. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: iphothifoliyo yemaloli agcwele ihlukaniswe ngemali yekonga yemalunga, njengeliphesenti.
help.institutional_capital: Tivikelo tekhopharethi letakhiwe ngesikhatsi, letivikela kulahlekelwa. Ayifaki emasheya lakatsengwe emalunga. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: inzuzo legciniwe kwengeta tivikelo temtsetfo kwengeta timo netincindzo.
help.institutional_capital_ratio_pct: Yincenye lengakanani yemphahla yekhopharethi levikelwe titivikelo tayo. Linani lelincane lemtsetfo ngu-8%, ngako lokuphakeme kusho sivikelo lesicinile kulokulahlekelwa. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imali yesikhungo ihlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.
help.institutional_capital_minimum_pct: Linani lelincane lemali yesikhungo lekhopharethi lekufanele ibe nalo, lelibekwe ngumtsetfo ku-8% yemphahla yonkhe. Lilinani lelicinile lekufananiswa, hhayi lelibikwe khopharethi. Ifomula: linani lelincane lemtsetfo lemali yesikhungo kuya kumphahla.
help.institutional_capital_excess_pct: Yincenye lengakanani izinga lemali yesikhungo lingetulu nome ngentasi kwelinani lelincane lema-8%. Lokuhle kusho kutsi linani lelincane lendluliwe; lokubi kusweleko lokudzinga simonyoro. Ifomula: izinga lemali yesikhungo kukhishwa linani lelincane, ngemaphesenti.
help.total_equity: Loko lokusala emalungeni ngemuva kwekukhokha tikweletu tonkhe. Ikhombisa lisiko lemali lenhle lekhopharethi. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe; nangabe akufakwanga kubalwa kusuka kumphahla nakutikweletu bese kuba kulinganiselwa. Ifomula: imali yemalunga yonkhe njengobe ibikiwe, nome kungenjalo imphahla yonkhe ikhishwe tikweletu.
help.share_capital: Imali lebeke emalunga ngekutsenga emasheya. Sabelo semalunga lesicondzile khopharethi. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imali yemasheya yonkhe lebikiwe.
help.retained_earnings: Inzuzo legciniwe khopharethi kusukela eminyakeni lendlulile esikhundleni sekukhishwa. Yakha emandla ekhopharethi awo. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: inzuzo legciniwe lebikiwe.
help.statutory_reserves: Tivikelo lekufanele khopharethi ibekele eceleni ngumtsetfo nome ngemitsetfo yayo kuvikela kulahlekelwa. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: tivikelo temtsetfo letihlangantisiwe letibikiwe.
help.total_income: Yonkhe imali khopharethi leyitfole ngemnyaka, ikakhulu kusuka enzalweni yemaloli netimali letinye. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imali yengenako yonkhe yemnyaka wanyalo lebikiwe.
help.total_expenditure: Yonkhe imali khopharethi leyisetjentise ngemnyaka kuchubeka nebhizinisi layo. Kufakiwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: tindleko tonkhe temnyaka wanyalo letibikiwe.
help.net_income: Loko lokusala ngemuva kwekukhokha tindleko tonkhe. Linani lelihle yinzuzo, lelibi kulahlekelwa. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: imali yengenako net njengobe ibikiwe, nome kungenjalo imali yengenako yonkhe ikhishwe tindleko tonkhe.
help.return_on_assets_pct: Yinzuzo lenganani lekhopharethi ienta ngakunye kwemphahla leyinayo. Lokuphakeme kusho kutsi imphahla isetjentiswa ngendlela lenenzuzo lenyenti. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe, ngesikhatsi lesibikiwe futsi akunyakaziswa. Ifomula: imali yengenako net ihlukaniswe ngemphahla yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.
help.operating_expense_ratio_pct: Yincenye lengakanani yakunye lekutfoliwe leyisetjentiswe tindleko. Ngentasi kwema-100% khopharethi yenta inzuzo; lokuphansi kungcono. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: tindleko tonkhe tihlukaniswe ngemali yengenako yonkhe, njengeliphesenti.
help.board_women_pct: Incenye yemalunga ebhodini labesifazane. Ikhombisa kutsi besifazane bayabandzakanyeka yini etincumeni letiphakeme. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: besifazane ebhodini bahlukaniswe ngawo onkhe emalunga ebhodini, njengeliphesenti.
help.executive_women_pct: Incenye yemalunga ekomitini lekuphatsa labesifazane. Ikhombisa kutsi besifazane bayabandzakanyeka yini ekuphatseni kwelilanga nelilanga. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: besifazane ekomitini lekuphatsa bahlukaniswe ngawo onkhe emalunga aso, njengeliphesenti.
help.credit_committee_women_pct: Incenye yemalunga ekomitini lesikweletu labesifazane. Ikhombisa kutsi besifazane bayabandzakanyeka yini etincumeni tekuboleka. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: besifazane ekomitini lesikweletu bahlukaniswe ngawo onkhe emalunga aso, njengeliphesenti.
help.agm_attendance_pct: Incenye yemalunga lasebentako labeta emhlanganweni wekugcina wa-Annual General Meeting. Ikhombisa kutsi emalunga abandzakanyeka kangakanani ekuphatseni. Kutsatfwe embikweni wemibuzo wesikhatsi lesikhetsiwe. Ifomula: emalunga labeta emhlanganweni wekugcina ahlukaniswe ngemalunga lasebentako, njengeliphesenti.
